Kill [[Lord Jadoth]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Kill Lord Jadoth in the [[City of Torc'qua]].
* *BONUS* Kill Lord Jadoth in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 15,000 [[Experience]]
* 2,000 [[Gold]]
* 750 [[Lightbringer rank|Lightbringer Points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 60 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
In the [[City of Torc'qua]], complete the quest [[The City of Torc'qua]] to spawn [[Lord Jadoth]]. See [[Mallyx the Unyielding (quest)]] for tactics against him.

The Zaishen quest only requires killing Lord Jadoth himself, but doing a bit of extra work to kill his mob will progress the Mallyx the Unyielding quest and reward you with a [[Torc'qua Chest]].
